quizzes.q: Which creature catches your eye?

opts.r: The One Who Wants to Float
opts.d: You really want to feel weightless and move forward without any effort. Drifting with the current now and then is like giving your heart a little vacation.
opts.tip: Find some time today to lie down and fully relax for five minutes.

opts.d: You feel especially at ease when someone's with you. Being surrounded by others reminds you that you're not facing things alone.
opts.tip: Message a friend today and tell them how your day went.

opts.t: An octopus hiding by the rocks
opts.r: The One Who Needs a Cozy Nook
opts.d: Lately you may really need a corner to hide away in for a bit. Keeping a little space and privacy for yourself is a gentle kind of self-care.
opts.tip: Give yourself some time today when you don't have to reply to any messages.

opts.t: A big sea turtle gliding by
opts.d: You know a lot of things can't be rushed, and swimming slowly can still take you far. Your calm is a very gentle kind of strength.
opts.tip: While doing something today, slow down just a little on purpose.

quizzes.title: Sky Lanterns on the Old Street
quizzes.story: On the old street of a mountain town at night, everyone is releasing sky lanterns, one orange glow after another rising slowly into the sky. You're handed a blank lantern and a brush, too. They say whatever you write on it will be gently carried away.
quizzes.q: What do you want the lantern to carry away?

opts.t: That thing you keep worrying about
opts.d: Something has been weighing on your heart for a long time, and you're actually ready to let it feel lighter. Being willing to let go is a very brave step.
opts.tip: Write down that worry today, then add one line: “I've done my best.”

opts.t: All the tiredness piled up lately
opts.d: You've been pushing forward for so long, and your heart is a little tired. Once tiredness is seen, it starts to feel lighter. You deserve a good rest.
opts.tip: Turn off the lights fifteen minutes earlier than usual tonight.

opts.d: You hold yourself to high standards, often stricter than you are with others. Try treating yourself the way you'd treat a good friend, and you'll feel your heart loosen up a lot.
opts.tip: When you make a small mistake today, tell yourself, “It's okay. I'll try again next time.”

opts.t: Write nothing, just watch it fly
opts.d: Your heart is actually feeling pretty light right now, and you know how to enjoy the beauty in front of you. Simply appreciating things is your best way to relax.
opts.tip: Find a pretty sight today and really look at it for one minute.

quizzes.title: The Hammock in the Orchard
quizzes.story: In an orchard one afternoon, a hammock hangs between two trees. You lie down, and it sways gently from side to side as sunlight filters through the leaves, falling on you in little dapples.
quizzes.q: As you sway, what do you most hope happens?

opts.t: Drifting off to sleep without noticing
opts.d: Your heart is asking you to get some real rest, no reason needed. Being able to fall asleep peacefully means you're taking good care of yourself.
opts.tip: This afternoon or before bed, give yourself ten minutes to close your eyes and rest.

opts.t: A fruit dropping right into your hand
opts.d: You really need some effortless good news to remind you that life has surprises for you too. Keep that hope alive. Little bits of luck often show up quietly.
opts.tip: Notice one little thing today that makes you think, “How lucky!”

opts.t: Someone nearby telling you a story
opts.d: You want someone by your side, not doing anything, just quietly keeping you company. That feeling of comfort is your fastest way to get your energy back.
opts.tip: Listen to an audiobook or a show you like today, and let a voice keep you company for a while.

opts.t: A breeze that keeps gently blowing
opts.r: The One Who Wants to Feel Light
opts.d: You'd love for the wind to blow your worries away and make your heart a little lighter. You've already worked so hard. Now you can let yourself breathe out.
opts.tip: Stand by a window or outside today, feel the breeze on your face and slowly breathe out three times.

quizzes.title: Seats Under the Planetarium Stars
quizzes.story: On a weekend afternoon, you and the person you like walk into the planetarium's domed theater. The seats slowly tilt back, the lights dim one by one, and the whole ceiling fills with stars. The guide says softly, “Try to find the one you like best.”
quizzes.q: In the projected night sky, where do you look first?

opts.d: In love, you like feelings that are clear and bright, with no guessing games. You openly let them know you care, which is why the people around you always feel so safe.
opts.tip: Tell someone important today one thing you admire about them.

opts.d: You believe love is built from little moments, slowly linked together. You remember what they said and the places you've been together, and in your heart those details become a story that's just yours.
opts.tip: Think of a little moment you two shared today, and send them a quick “I still remember that.”

opts.r: The Heart That Wants to Be Near
opts.d: You treasure the space between two people, and just a little closeness makes you feel warm. You don't need grand drama. Knowing you're always there for each other is enough.
opts.tip: Sit side by side with someone important today for a while. No phones, just being together.

opts.t: The Milky Way at the edge of the sky
opts.d: Your love has lots of room, ready to hold their differences and changes. You believe a good relationship lets both people be comfortably themselves, and look toward faraway places together.
opts.tip: Ask them about a small dream for the future today, and just listen quietly.

quizzes.title: The Ferry Deck at Dusk
quizzes.story: At dusk, you and the person you like hop on a little ferry to take a walk on the other side of the river. The engine hums low, the river glows orange-red in the sunset, and the wind tousles your hair.
quizzes.q: Once the boat sets off, where do you stand on the deck?

opts.t: At the bow, watching the shore ahead
opts.d: You like two people heading in the same direction, and you often wonder, “Where should we go next?” With you around, love is always full of excitement and momentum.
opts.tip: Plan one small thing with them today that you'd like to do together next week.

opts.t: At the stern, watching the wake
opts.d: You know how to savor things, and every stretch of road you've traveled is precious to you. Your tenderness lies in remembering, which makes them feel truly held in your heart.
opts.tip: Dig out an old photo of you two today and look at it together.

opts.t: Leaning on the rail, shoulder to shoulder
opts.d: For you, the best view is having them by your side. You value quality time, and even standing together in silence feels full. You give off a steady calm, like a harbor they can always come back to.
opts.tip: Walk a little way with them today. No need to talk about anything in particular.

opts.t: In the cabin, by the window
opts.d: You think first about whether they're cold or tired, and quietly find a comfy spot for you both. Your love is down-to-earth, always tucked into thoughtful little plans.
opts.tip: Get them a small something today, like a glass of warm water or a piece of candy.

quizzes.title: The Late-Night Vending Machine
quizzes.story: On your walk home, you and the person you like stop in front of a glowing vending machine. The night is quiet except for the machine's low hum. They drop in some coins, turn to you and say, “My treat. You pick.”
quizzes.q: Which button do you press?

opts.t: A warm can of hot cocoa
opts.d: You like love with some warmth to it, and a little sweetness is enough to soften your heart. The people you're with often melt a little in that warmth of yours.
opts.tip: Have a warm drink today, and send a goodnight message to someone important.

opts.d: You love sharing the same feelings, and “we're the same” feels like a sweet kind of happiness. The way you're all in makes it clear to them that they're the one you chose.
opts.tip: Do the same small thing together today, like watching the same short video.

opts.d: You quietly remember everything they like, and you always want to make them happy. Your love is attentive, often ready before they even ask.
opts.tip: Do one small thing for them today that you know they'll like.

opts.t: Ask them to pick one for you
opts.d: You're happy to hand little decisions over to them and enjoy being taken care of. That trust is a kind of tenderness too, and it makes them feel needed.
opts.tip: Ask someone important to recommend something today, then actually give it a try.

quizzes.title: The Riverside Fireworks Festival
quizzes.story: On a summer night, the riverbank is packed with people here for the fireworks, and the air smells of street-food skewers and soda. You and the person you like finally find a little patch of grass to sit on. The announcement has just ended when the first firework whooshes up into the sky.
quizzes.q: The moment the fireworks burst open, what are you doing?

opts.t: Looking up at the sky full of fireworks
opts.d: You know how to be fully present, tucking beautiful moments into your heart together with them. Your focus gives every moment you share real meaning.
opts.tip: When you're with someone important today, put your phone aside first.

opts.t: Sneaking a look at their face
opts.d: For you, the best view is often the person beside you. Your affection is shy but sincere, hidden in the glances they never notice.
opts.tip: Find a chance today to tell them which of their expressions you like most.

opts.d: You really want to save your time together so you can relive it later. You give your relationship lots of warm moments to replay.
opts.tip: Make a little album today with your latest photos together.

opts.d: At important moments, you're willing to take the first step and let them feel how you feel. Your courage is gentle, bringing you a little closer bit by bit.
opts.tip: Invite someone important today to do something you've both been looking forward to.

quizzes.title: Tickets for the Midnight Show
quizzes.story: On a weekend night, you and the person you like decide on a whim to catch a midnight movie. The ticket machine screen glows, and all four movies left still have two seats together. They let you choose.
quizzes.q: Which movie do you pick?

opts.d: Deep down you always believe love can be beautiful, and you're happy to create little romantic moments for them. Your hopes aren't pressure. They're what makes you both shine.
opts.tip: Plan a little surprise for them today, like a song or a sweet message.

opts.d: You like getting to know someone slowly, and you're full of curiosity about their thoughts and inner world. Talking with you always goes deep, and people feel taken seriously.
opts.tip: Ask them a question today you've never asked, and really listen to the answer.

opts.d: You keep a sense of innocence in love and find joy in little things. With you, they often forget their worries and end up laughing along.
opts.tip: Do something a bit childish but really fun with someone important today.

opts.d: You long to see the bigger world with them, and you love shared experiences more than a moment of excitement. Your love has a sense of wide-open space that lets the relationship breathe.
opts.tip: Chat with them today about the next place you'd like to go together.

quizzes.title: The Train Doors on the Platform
quizzes.story: The weekend together flew by, and you walk the person you like to the platform. The train pulls in, they step aboard, then turn around to look at you. An announcement says the doors are about to close.
quizzes.q: Before the doors close, what do you do?

opts.t: Wave until they're out of sight
opts.d: Your feelings are real and full, and even when saying goodbye you don't hide how much you care. That honest reluctance will keep them feeling warm the whole ride.
opts.tip: Message someone important today: “Time with you goes by so fast.”

opts.t: Say “Text me when you get there”
opts.d: Your love lives in every little reminder, and you always want to know they're safe. You let them know that wherever they go, someone is thinking of them.
opts.tip: Remind someone important of one small thing today, and add “I'm here for you.”

opts.t: Slip them a piece of candy
opts.d: You're great at leaving a bit of sweetness at goodbyes, so they think of you on the way. Your gestures are small, but they often make someone's whole day.
opts.tip: Prepare a little something today and leave it where they'll be sure to find it.

opts.d: You see parting as the start of the next time you meet, and your heart is always full of anticipation. Your optimism keeps this relationship light and hopeful.
opts.tip: Set the date for your next meetup today, and put it in your calendar.

quizzes.title: The Fogged-Up Train Window
quizzes.story: On a winter morning, you and the person you like are on a cozy local train, and the windows have fogged up from the warmth inside. They reach out a finger, draw a tiny picture in the mist, then turn to look at you.
quizzes.q: What do you draw next to it in reply?

opts.d: When someone shows you their feelings, you always answer openly, never leaving their affection hanging. Your directness and warmth make it clear they're treasured.
opts.tip: When you reply to someone important today, add one heartfelt line.

opts.d: You love noticing how they look, even their tiniest expressions. Being seen like this makes someone feel truly special.
opts.tip: Tell them today about a strength you've noticed that they might not see in themselves.

opts.t: A line linking the two drawings
opts.d: For you, love is two people slowly becoming connected. You love the feeling of “us,” and you naturally bring them into your life and plans.
opts.tip: Invite them into one small part of your everyday life today.

opts.d: You treasure each ordinary yet special day, and you always want to hold onto the good parts. Your love is long-lasting, and it lets them know every day is remembered.

opts.d: You believe slow is actually faster, adjusting step by step until things are just right. Your steadiness helps results last a long time.
opts.tip: Move a long-term project forward by five minutes today.

quizzes.title: Your Stall at the Weekend Market
quizzes.story: You've rented a little stall at the weekend craft market, a wooden table set up under a canvas canopy. The stallholder next door is hanging string lights, and the air smells of coffee and fresh-baked cookies. You're about to set out what you're selling today.
quizzes.q: What does your stall sell?

opts.d: You're happy to spend time doing something well, and your work is full of heart. That focus and patience is something few people have.
opts.tip: Pick a small task today and finish it to a quality you're truly happy with.

opts.d: You love face-to-face interaction, and a satisfied smile gives you a special sense of achievement. Your warmth makes people want to keep coming back.
opts.tip: Pour a glass of water or a drink for a coworker or family member today.

opts.d: You love passing good things on, and you're happy to teach others what you know. Your sharing often quietly helps lots of people.
opts.tip: Recommend a book or a good tip to a friend today.

opts.d: You're great at turning what makes people special into something you can see, and you have a one-of-a-kind way of looking at things. That creativity is your brightest strength at work.
opts.tip: Turn some information into a simple drawing today, as a new way to organize it.

quizzes.title: The Music Box in the Antique Shop
quizzes.story: Down a lane there's a tiny antique shop, its shelves lined with all kinds of old things. You pick up a wooden music box and gently wind it. The lid opens, and a tinkling tune slowly flows out.
quizzes.q: What's turning inside the music box?

opts.r: The One Who Wants to Stretch Out
opts.d: You may have been wound up tight lately, and deep down you really want to move freely. Give yourself some room to stretch, and your heart will loosen up too.
opts.tip: Put on a song you like today, and sway gently to the beat.

opts.r: The One Who Misses Carefree Days
opts.d: There's a carefree memory living in your heart, and that's where you recharge. Visiting it now and then reminds you that happiness is actually simple.
opts.tip: Eat a snack today that you loved as a kid.

opts.t: A little bird spreading its wings
opts.r: Time for a Change of Air
opts.d: You may need to step away from the familiar for a bit and give your heart a breath of fresh air. You don't have to go far. A tiny change works wonders.
opts.tip: Step outside during your lunch break today, and soak up five minutes of sun.

opts.t: A little boat on the waves
opts.d: You've been working so hard to keep everything under control, and now is a great time to learn to go with the flow. Let things take their time, and you'll find you have more breathing room than you think.
opts.tip: Pick something that isn't urgent today, and leave it for tomorrow without worry.

quizzes.title: Bubbles in the Park
quizzes.story: In the park on a sunny day, you buy a bottle of bubble solution. One gentle blow, and a string of round bubbles floats out, shimmering with rainbow colors in the sunlight. The biggest one slowly drifts far away.
quizzes.q: Where does that biggest bubble end up?

opts.t: Over the treetops, higher and higher
opts.r: The One Ready to Lighten Up
opts.d: Some things in your heart can slowly be set down now, and you're more ready than you think. Let them float away. What's left will be a lighter you.
opts.tip: Write down one little worry you want to let go of today, then crumple up the paper and toss it.

opts.d: Lately you really need that simple, no-reason kind of happy. Joy doesn't have to be big. One little surprise can light up a whole day.
opts.tip: Plan one small thing today that's just plain fun.

opts.t: Resting on the water for a moment
opts.r: The One Who Needs a Pause
opts.d: You've been moving forward nonstop, and now is a great time to pause for a bit. A short stop isn't a waste. It's how you get your footing back.
opts.tip: Sit for three minutes today doing nothing, just listening to the sounds around you.

opts.d: You know that when feelings build up, they need a way out, and you're great at finding your own. Talking it out and writing it down are both great ways to let go.
opts.tip: Talk with someone you trust today about what's been wearing you out lately.

quizzes.title: Biking Past the Rice Fields
quizzes.story: In the evening, you ride your bike past a rice field, the wind sending waves through the rice. The sky is tinted pinkish orange by the sunset, and ahead is a long, gentle downhill.
quizzes.q: What do you do right now?

opts.t: Take your feet off the pedals and coast
opts.r: The One Who Wants to Ease Off
opts.d: You've been pushing hard for a long time, and deep down you really want to “not push” for a while. Letting the wind carry you is a great way to move forward too.
opts.tip: Choose one task today and let yourself do it the easiest way possible.

opts.d: You know how to hit pause in the middle of busy days and tuck lovely moments into your heart. That sensitivity keeps refilling your energy.
opts.tip: Look up at the color of the sky this evening.

opts.t: Hum a song as you ride
opts.d: You're great at finding a good mood for yourself, and even when you're tired, you can find little joys. Your lightness is the most natural stress relief.
opts.tip: Hum a song you like today, on the road or while doing chores.

opts.t: Ride slowly and enjoy the breeze
opts.d: You like living at your own speed, in no hurry to reach the finish line. When you slow down, you feel even more of life's little joys.
opts.tip: Put your phone down at a meal today, and really enjoy your food.

quizzes.title: Fireflies by the Mountain
quizzes.story: On an early summer night, you stroll along a little mountain path, insects chirping softly all around. As you round a bend, little green lights suddenly flicker on in the grass, more and more of them, like stars that have fallen to the ground.
quizzes.q: How do you most want to enjoy the fireflies?

opts.t: Let one land on your fingertip
opts.r: The One Who Needs a Little Kindness
opts.d: Lately you may really need some gentle company. Just a little is enough. You deserve to be treated well, and to be a little kinder to yourself.
opts.tip: Tell yourself “You've worked so hard” today, and really mean it.

opts.t: Stand still and watch the whole glow
opts.d: Your heart really needs some quiet time with nothing to think about. Once you settle down, you'll naturally recharge.
opts.tip: Turn off your screens for ten minutes before bed tonight, and sit quietly in the dim light.

opts.t: Follow the lights a little way
opts.d: Even under stress, your curiosity and sense of wonder haven't gone anywhere. Following a little curiosity often leads you out of a slump.
opts.tip: Browse a little shop today that you've never been to.

opts.t: Take a photo and send it to friends
opts.d: For you, sharing something beautiful is a way to relax. Being connected with the people who matter keeps your heart steady.
opts.tip: Send a friend a photo you think is lovely today.

quizzes.title: The Sun-Dried Comforter
quizzes.story: On a sunny weekend, you carry your comforter out to the balcony and let it soak up the sun all afternoon. When you bring it in at dusk, it's puffy and soft and smells like warm sunshine.
quizzes.q: Back in your room with the comforter in your arms, what's the first thing you do?

opts.d: You've really been working hard lately, and your heart keeps saying, “I want to lie down.” Resting well isn't being lazy. It gives tomorrow's you more strength.
opts.tip: Go to bed thirty minutes earlier tonight, and get a really good sleep.

opts.t: Bury your face in it and breathe in
opts.d: You know how to find contentment in little things, and a hint of sunshine scent can make you smile. That ability is your best way to handle stress.
opts.tip: Find a scent that makes you feel safe today, and take a good long sniff.

opts.d: For you, putting things away and freshening up your space helps your heart settle too. It's a lovely way you take care of yourself.
opts.tip: Spend ten minutes today tidying one small area by your bed or on your desk.

opts.t: Wrap up in it and curl up on the sofa
opts.d: You really want some warm, undisturbed time. Wrap yourself up and curl up for a while. You deserve that kind of gentleness.
opts.tip: Give yourself some time today when you don't reply to messages, and just curl up.

quizzes.title: The Wind Chime Shop
quizzes.story: On the old street there's a little shop selling wind chimes, its eaves hung with chimes big and small. A breeze blows through, and the whole shop rings out with clear, bright sounds at once. You decide to take one home and hang it by your window.
quizzes.q: Which wind chime do you pick?

opts.d: Your mind may be holding quite a lot lately, and you really want everything to feel clear. Sort through it slowly, and your heart will become bright and clear again.
opts.tip: Cross off one thing on your to-do list today that you no longer need.

opts.r: The Heart That Misses the Sea
opts.d: You need a feeling of open space and freedom, to give your heart a bit more room. Even if you can't travel far, you can find a little taste of the sea for yourself.
opts.tip: Listen to ocean waves today, and close your eyes for three minutes.

opts.d: You like calm, natural things, and they make you feel safe. Give yourself some down-to-earth time, and your heart will slowly settle.
opts.tip: Take a walk somewhere with trees today, and touch a trunk or some leaves.

opts.r: The One Who Needs a Lift
opts.d: You may need a bright, clear sound to gently wake you from tiredness. A small change is enough to lift your spirits again.
opts.tip: Open a window today, and let fresh air flow into the room.

quizzes.title: The Evening Breeze on the Rooftop
quizzes.story: After a long day, you climb up to your apartment's rooftop for some air. The evening breeze is cool, and a neighbor's potted plants sway gently in the corner. You lean against the railing and take in the whole night view.
quizzes.q: Where does your gaze land first?

opts.d: Even when you're tired, there's still a warm drive inside you to keep going. Rest well first, and that strength will carry you even further.
opts.tip: Set up something to look forward to tomorrow, like a favorite breakfast.

opts.t: The brightest star in the sky
opts.d: You may be waiting for something to get better, and it really is on its way. Holding onto a little hope can light up your heart.
opts.tip: Write down something you've been looking forward to lately.

opts.t: The potted plants swaying in the corner
opts.d: Deep down, you really want some steady, familiar company. Taking care of the little things around you can make you feel cared for, too.
opts.tip: Water the plants at home today, or bring home a little potted plant.

opts.t: Clouds drifting slowly in the distance
opts.r: The One Who Wants to Slow Down
opts.d: Your pace may have been a bit fast lately, and your heart wants to slow down with the clouds. It's okay to go slower. You won't fall behind.
opts.tip: Slow down on purpose as you walk today, for a short stretch.

quizzes.title: The Rainbow After the Rain
quizzes.story: An afternoon thunderstorm has just passed. The puddles on the ground sparkle, and the air smells so fresh. You push open the door, step outside, and see a soft rainbow hanging across the sky.
quizzes.q: Which color of the rainbow do you notice first?

opts.d: You may have been giving a lot lately, and you really want to be wrapped in warmth. Let yourself get close to warm people and things, and your energy will slowly come back.
opts.tip: Make yourself a hot drink today, and sip it slowly to the end.

opts.d: You really need some natural, fresh space to let your heart breathe. Nature is a wonderful charging station for you.
opts.tip: Find something green to look at for a while today, like a park, street trees or a landscape photo.

opts.d: Your mind has been spinning fast lately, and you really want a sky with nothing in it. Zoning out now and then is a great way to let your thoughts line up again.
opts.tip: Find five minutes today to look out the window and think about nothing.

opts.d: You feel things deeply and often quietly work through a lot of emotions. That sensitivity is precious. Just remember to save some gentleness for yourself, too.
opts.tip: Write a few lines today about how you feel right now. It doesn't need to be complete.
